name: Dragon Ball Z Special 1: Tatta Hitori no Saishuu Kessen
name_english: Dragon Ball Z: Bardock - The Father of Goku
name_romanji: Dragon Ball Z: Bardock - The Father of Goku
original_title: ドラゴンボールZ たったひとりの最終決戦〜フリーザに挑んだZ戦士 孫悟空の父〜
description: Bardock, Son Goku's father, is a low-ranking Saiyan soldier who was given the power to see into the future by the last remaining alien on a planet he just destroyed. He witnesses the destruction of his race and must now do his best to stop Frieza's impending massacre.
